A second use (and research avenue) of priors arises when we consider source reconstruction algorithms that are conditioned on multimodal measurements. In such a case, it is prudent to consider that the individual measurement modalities may not contribute equally to the source estimation, either because they contain (random) measurement noise of different magnitudes or they may be contaminated by (non-random) nuisance sources.
